request: Design a Python-based Gallery Browser application for Linux with PyQt6, GStreamer preview, SQLite metadata, and ComfyUI PNG workflow support. The app needs: 3-pane layout (tree, file grid/list, preview+info), centralized thumbnail cache, batch operations, drag-drop, Linux file manager integration, collections/tags, comparisons, image sequence playback, and format conversions.

config.context: [Core application architecture, tech stack decisions, module structure] Need a pattern that fits Qt's model/view and supports 3-pane layout, caching, and background tasks.

architecture.finding: Use PyQt6 with an MVC-style architecture for the core app (model for data/DB, views for UI panes, controllers for actions/events).
